hook: A single oral dose of the actinide chelator HOPO 14-1 up to 7500 mg caused no serious harm in 42 adults.

readout.label: Highest single oral dose, no serious events

summary: In a phase 1 trial, 42 healthy adults took one oral dose from 100 to 7500 mg of a drug meant to remove radioactive actinides from the body. There were no serious adverse events; mild to moderate diarrhea, vomiting, headache, and fatigue were the main side effects, worst at high doses. Most of the drug left in feces. It was a single-site, nonrandomized safety study in healthy people, so it does not show that the drug removes contamination.
title: HOPO 14-1, an Oral Actinide Chelator: A Phase 1 Nonrandomized Clinical Trial.
